name: plan_next
returns: string | null (current step or null if done)

name: plan_advance
returns: Plan (mark current step done, move to next)

name: buf_from_bytes
returns: string (alias: identity, for clarity in code)

name: buf_to_binary
returns: binary string suitable for raw TCP writes

name: retry_silent
returns: any|null  (retry n times, return null on final failure)

name: memoize
returns: fn  (return memoized version of fn, keyed by JSON args)

name: once
returns: fn  (return version of fn that only executes once)

name: tap
returns: value  (call fn(value) for side effects, return value unchanged)

name: crypto_rsa_jwk_to_public_pem
returns: string | nil (validated public RSA JWK only)

name: sha256_short
returns: string (first 8 chars, useful as short ID)

name: uuid_short
returns: string (8-char short ID from random bytes)

name: extract_json
returns: any|null  (extract first JSON object/array from text)

name: json_merge
returns: object (shallow merge, obj2 wins on conflict)

name: json_str
returns: string (serialize to JSON string, handles Maps)

name: str_count
returns: number (count occurrences of sub in str)

name: is_error
returns: boolean (check if value is an error)

name: file_is_file
returns: boolean (check if path is a file)

name: file_is_dir
returns: boolean (check if path is a directory)

name: server_req_params
returns: object  (all URL params as an object)

name: res_cpu_pct
returns: number (1-min loadavg based, avoids busy wait)

name: res_find_free_port
returns: number | null  (first free port in range)

name: shell_ok
returns: boolean (returns true if exit code is 0)

name: shell_pipe
returns: string (pipe output of cmd1 into cmd2)

name: shell_exists
returns: boolean (check if a program is in PATH)

name: set_interval
returns: number (fn: function name string, ms: interval, on-error: \uCF5C\uBC31 \uC624\uB958 \uCC98\uB9AC \uD568\uC218)

name: set_timeout
returns: number (fn: function name string, ms: delay, on-error: \uCF5C\uBC31 \uC624\uB958 \uCC98\uB9AC \uD568\uC218)
